title: DXF appData and raw-carrier variant-node admission
mode: local implementation and generated fast verification
scope: Charge entity and table-entry application-data variants before materialization
Charge typed groups materialized by the common raw-carrier capture path

implementation.change: Entity/table-entry parseDxfGroups charges the opener and each child appData variant. captureRawGroup charges each typed raw carrier group and restores its prior retained-byte lease amount if node admission fails. Raw-backed appData charges the opener and each copied raw-group variant as distinct materializations. The installed API note describes these selected routes and exclusions.
